newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ FBT prescribed rate rises to 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ FBT prescribed rate rises to 11.5 pct.

text.p: The rate of interest used to calculate the fringe benefit value of low-interest employment related loans has been increased to 11.5 percent for the quarter commencing October 1, 1996, Minister of Revenue Peter Dunne said on Tuesday.
This rate replaces the existing rate of 10.6 percent.
Dunne said the new rate was a reflection of the recent rise in market rates.
